defects: THE PLATFORM STATUS MAP HAD DRIFTED INTO A LIE AND NOTHING READ IT. scripts/build_digest.py carried a hand-maintained PLATFORM_STATUS dict that no code path used; it still labelled MentionMatch 'pre-launch' on the day the site shipped a live product behind an account. THE CARRIED SENDABLE ROW'S ROUTE PROSE COULD ONLY GROW. `contact_append` adds a sentence every run it is used, so the Fast Company row's contact field now carries a 2026-10-18 SMTP caveat above today's re-probe. Run notes can now supersede that prose outright with `contact_replace`, and today's file uses it, so the row states today's byte counts, today's address counts and one deliverability caveat instead of an accumulating stack.

THE RUN'S 10MB SITEMAP WAS BEING COMMITTED EVERY DAY FOR NO REASON. `haro_window.py` writes the full Sourcee sitemap (9.4MB today, ~245,000 loc/lastmod pairs) beside the window JSON, and 25 of those files were tracked - roughly 250MB of raw XML across the monitor's history, all of it re-derivable by one command. The window JSON, which holds the only measurement taken off the sitemap, is still committed; the raw XML is now gitignored, and the existing files are left in place rather than rewriting history.
